claim_ad_instrument_fidelity.finding: The design card's AD column (applicability_domain_tanimoto) is NOT the R-C03 raw-training-set-NN convention. Its true documented method, recovered from polyuniverse_epoxy_tg_conformal_and_applicability_domain_receipt.v1.json (sha256 2c7b807b187a520800d563ca647636355f318044d469246a5a8bd823928bab65), is 'morgan_fingerprint_tanimoto_to_nearest_training_scaffold_representative' (Morgan r=2/256-bit, Bemis & Murcko 1996 generic scaffolds, n_scaffolds_train=1106 from n_polymers_train=72694). The original compute script producing that column is not present in the repository (only its receipt survives), so this fire built a best-effort, method/bit-width-matching reproduction (Bemis-Murcko scaffold dedup + 256-bit Morgan NN, whole-molecule fingerprint fallback for acyclic/no-ring-system queries) and used it as the PRIMARY AD instrument for the sweep below (applied consistently to all 3 evaluators, not just Tg).
claim_ad_instrument_fidelity.honest_caveat: This reproduction is close but NOT exact (max abs delta 0.097 similarity units, on IPDA). Because the original compute script is unrecoverable, exact byte-for-byte reproduction of the design card's per-amine AD numbers is NOT claimed. Notably, this fire's reproduction finds IPDA ALSO fails the AD>=0.30 gate (0.245 < 0.30), i.e. 5/5 canonical amines excluded rather than the reported 4/5 -- the qualitative claim (severe exclusion at 0.30) is not weakened by this discrepancy, it is if anything strengthened, but the exact count is flagged as a residual reproduction gap, not silently resolved in either direction.

claim_under_attack.claim_text: The applicability-domain threshold trades coverage against error in a measurable way; the current AD>=0.30 gate excludes 4/5 canonical industrial amines.

honest_caveat_lower_bound: MAE-among-admitted at every threshold/evaluator cell above is measured WITHIN the same corpus family (Polyuniverse Epoxy or RadonPy PI1070) that also supplied the training set, using the module's own group-safe (cross-macro-chemotype) held-out split -- not against the actual deployment population of novel marine-coating epoxy-amine candidates (e.g. the grammar-38 / real industrial amines), which sit further outside these corpora than the held-out test molecules typically do. It is therefore a LOWER BOUND on true deployment error: true error for genuinely novel candidates admitted at any threshold is expected to be >= the reported MAE, not <=.

objective: Quantify the applicability-domain (AD) coverage-vs-error frontier so the coating-candidate-design-card's AD>=0.30 admission gate becomes an informed product decision instead of an arbitrary constant: sweep the AD similarity threshold over {0.20,0.25,0.30,0.35,0.40} for Tg, density, and refractive_index, on the module's own group-safe held-out split, reporting coverage / MAE-among-admitted (+95% bootstrap CI) / n_admitted at each cell, plus admission status of the 5 canonical epoxy-amines and the grammar-38 novel hardener proposals as the deployment-realistic query set.

positive_control_across_evaluators.how_planted: In ad_informativeness_check() (compute_ad_frontier.py), sim_test is permuted with a fixed-seed RNG before recomputing the Spearman rho against the UNCHANGED abs_err_test array, run in the same script execution as the real (unshuffled) measurement -- no re-fetch of data, only the AD-to-error pairing is broken.
positive_control_across_evaluators.interpretation: Tg: real AD-vs-error Spearman rho=-0.256 (p=4.6e-8), a statistically significant, measurable negative relationship (higher AD -> lower error), confirming the claim's 'measurable way' language for the evaluator the design card's AD column actually gates. Shuffled (planted defect): rho collapses to +0.026 (p=0.58, not significant) -- the attack has real power to detect a broken/uninformative AD instrument. density and refractive_index: real rho is directionally consistent (-0.156, -0.294) but NOT statistically significant at n_test=16 (p=0.56, p=0.27) -- honestly reported as underpowered/inconclusive rather than confirmed, since the macro-bisection held-out set for RadonPy PI1070 is small by construction. Shuffled controls still collapse toward zero/non-significance for both, confirming the harness has power even where the real-data signal itself is not statistically established.
positive_control_across_evaluators.planted_defect: Deterministic single-permutation shuffle of each evaluator's AD-similarity array against its abs-error array (same seed=%d, np.random.RandomState.permutation), breaking the correspondence between an admitted molecule's AD score and its actual prediction error.

recommended_followups: If the original AD-computation script (nearest-scaffold-representative, 256-bit) can be recovered or its author identified, re-run this sweep against the byte-exact instrument to close the residual fidelity gap flagged in claim_ad_instrument_fidelity.

density/refractive_index frontier significance is limited by RadonPy PI1070's small (n=16) macro-bisection minority chemotype; a larger or differently-partitioned group-safe RadonPy split would sharpen the AD-vs-error correlation estimate.

why: The claim's two components are evaluated separately and honestly. (1) 'AD threshold trades coverage against error in a measurable way': CONFIRMED with statistical significance for Tg (the evaluator the design card's own AD column actually gates; rho=-0.26, p<1e-7) via a genuinely falsifying test (positive control: shuffled AD scores collapse the correlation, proving the test has power); directionally consistent but not statistically significant for density/refractive_index given the tiny (n=16) group-safe held-out set for RadonPy PI1070 -- reported as inconclusive, not silently folded into a blanket CONFIRMED. (2) '0.30 gate excludes 4/5 canonical industrial amines': a best-effort, method-matching reproduction of the design card's own AD instrument (256-bit Bemis-Murcko scaffold-NN, since the raw compute script is not in the repo) finds 5/5 excluded at >=0.30, not 4/5 -- the qualitative severity of the claim SURVIVES (if anything strengthened), but the exact count is a residual, honestly-flagged reproduction gap rather than an exact match. Overall: SURVIVED, with two named caveats (density/RI significance, exact-count fidelity) carried forward rather than hidden.
